entities.summary:
Bente Pedersen is a Norwegian novelist. She was born in Skibotn. She has written many historical novels, for example Raija, Rosa, Sara, Liljene and Huset arent. Pedersen has also written many individual books:Mannen som fløy (1999)
Vi står han av (2004)
Best uten ball? (2005)
